cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Not Dismissed
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by treating departure as a privilege only you can grant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. The shop's shut, but wait by the till until I dismiss you. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've counted it. My daughter's waiting outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Bring her in. I can check the cash while you help with her homework.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's finished it. Our taxi's here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll finish your dismissal in the taxi. You may sit down, but tell him departure still needs my approval.
